title: Affine exact intersection-filtration models of stabilized kernel stalks
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, I a quasi-coherent ideal, alpha:F -> H a map of coherent formal modules [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], c a stabilization bound, and j:S -> F a natural transformation identifying S_m with the image of ker(alpha_(m+c)) in F_m, with stabilized images independent of l >= m+c. For any affine open U put A=Gamma(U,O_X), R=the I(U)-adic completion and K=I(U)R. There exist a finite R-module N and a submodule L of N such that for each x in U and each germ-compatible unit-stalk identification e, there are an O_(X,x)-module M, compatible surjective linear maps p_m:M -> (S_m)_x, and an order homomorphism phi from R-submodules of L to O_(X,x)-submodules of M. For every r>=0, phi(K^r L)=J^r M, where J is the stalk image of I [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk]. For every m, ker(p_m)=phi((K^(m+1)N).comap(L inclusion)), the localized intersection filtration. There is no boundedness conclusion and no finite-generation assertion over the stalk ring.

source.place: Lemma 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian), affine calculation K prime_m = K/(K intersect I^m M), using Lemma 087W; source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087X and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087W

proof.text: Apply the affine section quotient theorem to choose N, its finiteness proof, L, and compatible surjective A-linear q_m with exact intersection kernels.

Coherence of the levels F_(m+c), H_(m+c), F_m implies quasi-coherence. The kernel of alpha_(m+c) and its transition image are quasi-coherent by the kernel and cokernel/image theorems. Transport the latter along hS_m to get quasi-coherence of S_m. The Lean proof performs this at every level.

For each x in U and each germ-compatible e, apply the general affine localization theorem with R the completion and D_m=(K^(m+1)N).comap(L.subtype). Its section zero criterion is exactly the affine intersection kernel formula. This supplies p_m, compatibility, phi, ideal-power preservation, and the required exact kernel formula. Package these with the same N,L, independent of x.

proof_origin.place: 087X affine K prime_m calculation, followed by generic affine localization (01IB, 01IC, 00CS); two-step stage-3 reduction with quasi-coherence proved in Lean

lean.statement:
theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_affine_stalk_filtration
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F H : CoherentFormalModule X I) (α : F ⟶ H)
    (c : ℕ) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj)
    (hc : ∀ (l m : ℕ) (h : m + c ≤ l),
      Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op l)) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_right m c) h)).op)) =
        Subobject.mk
          (Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
            F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op)))
    (hS : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ e : S.obj (op m) ≅
      Abelian.image (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op),
      e.hom ≫ Abelian.image.ι (kernel.ι (α.hom.app (op (m + c))) ≫
        F.obj.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right m c)).op) = j.app (op m))
    (U : X.affineOpens) :
    let A := Γ(X, U.1)
    let R := AdicCompletion (I.ideal U) A
    let K := (I.ideal U).map (algebraMap A R)
    ∃ N : ModuleCat.{u} R, Module.Finite R N ∧
      ∃ L : Submodule R N, ∀ (x : X), x ∈ U.1 →
        ∀ e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≅
            ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x),
        (∀ (V : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ V) (r : Γ(X, V)),
          e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf
            V x hx r) = X.presheaf.germ V x hx r) →
        let T := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x
        let J : Ideal (X.presheaf.stalk x) := LinearMap.range (T.map I.toModulesι ≫ e.hom).hom
        ∃ M : ModuleCat.{u} (X.presheaf.stalk x),
          ∃ p : ∀ m : ℕ, M →ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x] T.obj (S.obj (op m)),
            (∀ m : ℕ, Function.Surjective (p m)) ∧
            (∀ (a b : ℕ) (h : a ≤ b) (z : M),
              (T.map (S.map (homOfLE h).op)).hom (p b z) = p a z) ∧
            ∃ φ : Submodule R L →o Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) M,
              (∀ r : ℕ, φ (K ^ r • (⊤ : Submodule R L)) =
                J ^ r • (⊤ : Submodule (X.presheaf.stalk x) M)) ∧
              (∀ m : ℕ, LinearMap.ker (p m) =
                φ ((K ^ (m + 1) • (⊤ : Submodule R N)).comap L.subtype))
